'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and Palestinian officials say that fighting between Israel and [[Gaza Strip|Palestine]] will continue while working toward a ceasefire. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ceasefire-still-elusive-israel-gaza-conflict-2021-05-18/ (Reuters)]
**The [[United States]] rejects a [[United Nations Security Council]] [[United Nations Security Council resolution|resolution]] that calls for a ceasefire in the conflict between Israel and Gaza. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/us-says-it-opposes-un-resolution-calling-for-gaza-cease-fire/2021/05/19/9f08d234-b8fb-11eb-bc4a-62849cf6cca9_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://news.yahoo.com/us-says-opposes-un-resolution-234011709.html (Yahoo! News)] 
*Spillover of the [[Colombian conflict]]
**Rebel forces confirm that former [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia]] leader [[Jesús Santrich]] has been killed in a cross-border operation in [[Zulia]], [[Venezuela]], by the [[National Army of Colombia]]. Five others were also killed in the operation on May 17. Santrich's rebel group says that the troops also cut off his little finger before withdrawing back across the border. Santrich was wanted by the [[United States]] on charges of [[drug trafficking]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/may/19/colombia-venezuela-farc-rebel-leader-killed (''The Guardian'')]
*Spillover of the [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants ambush a patrol in [[Lamu County]], [[Kenya]], killing seven soldiers. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/seven-kenyan-soldiers-killed-in-jihadi-ambush-in-lamu-county/2021/05/19/fde9fbc4-b8c5-11eb-bc4a-62849cf6cca9_story.html?outputType=amp (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Manhunt for Jürgen Conings]]
**A [[Manhunt (law enforcement)|manhunt]] is ongoing for a [[Far-right politics|far-right extremist]], identified as a soldier, in [[Dilsen-Stokkem]], [[Limburg (Belgium)|Limburg]], [[Belgium]], after threatening [[virologist]] [[Marc Van Ranst]]. The suspect is heavily armed and considered as a serious threat. Four [[rocket launcher]]s were found in his car. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57168576 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****It is revealed that the [[Ganges]] river in [[India]] has had hundreds of human bodies floating in its waters and buried in its banks in recent days, including some thought to have died of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-57154564 (BBC News)]
****An anti-fungal drug, [[Amphotericin B]], used in the treatment of a rare infection called [[mucormycosis]], or "black fungus", is in short supply across [[States of India|states]] in India. Immunity to this infection can be reduced by the use of steroids in severely ill COVID-19 patients. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-57167322 (BBC News)]
****India reports a new world record of 4,529 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]]s from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 283,248. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/india-reports-record-4529-daily-covid-19-deaths (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 6,075 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 485,496. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2021/05/19/record-high-6075-covid-19-cases-over-2000-in-selangor/ (''Free Malaysia Today'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
****[[Vice President of the Philippines|Vice President]] [[Leni Robredo]] receives her first dose of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://cnnphilippines.com/news/2021/5/19/VP-Leni-Robredo-AstraZeneca-COVID-vaccine-first-dose.html (CNN Philippines)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] raises its COVID-19 alert level to level 3 nationwide, which is the same level as [[Taipei]] and [[New Taipei City]], where [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask]]s are required to be worn at all times and gatherings of more than five people indoors and ten people outdoors are banned amid an increase in the number of locally transmitted cases. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/may/19/taiwan-raises-covid-alert-level-amid-rise-in-infections (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports its first four cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant, which was first discovered in [[India]]. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2021/05/19/coronavirus-first-cases-of-indian-variant-detected/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****Restaurants, bars, and cafés are reopened in [[France]] for outdoor dining for the first time in six months. Museums, theatres, and other cultural venues are also reopened as the curfew is changed to 9:00 p.m. as part of an easing of restrictions. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/grand-day-for-the-french-cafe-and-bistro-terraces-reopen/2021/05/19/50a5aac2-b86f-11eb-bc4a-62849cf6cca9_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210519-live-france-reopens-caf%C3%A9s-and-cultural-venues-after-six-month-covid-19-closure (France 24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***Argentina reports 39,652 new cases of COVID-19, a record for the second consecutive day. This subsequently brings the national total to 3.4 million. [https://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/269554207/argentina-daily-covid-19-cases-hit-record-high (Big News Network)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
***[[Zimbabwe]] reports its first cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant. The variant had been detected among a group of people in the central town of [[Kwekwe]] after a student returned from [[India]] on April 29. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/zimbabwe-reports-first-cases-coronavirus-variant-india-2021-05-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The U.S. surpasses 33 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.kiro7.com/news/trending/coronavirus-total-us-covid-19-cases-top-33-million-death-toll-creeps-past-587000/TRED7KLK6JHXJGZMLL2RGPAXNQ/ (KIRO-TV)]
*A [[tabular iceberg]] slightly larger than the size of [[Mallorca]], dubbed A-76, calves from the [[Ronne Ice Shelf]] in [[Antarctica]]'s [[Weddell Sea]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/05/19/world/iceberg-a-76-antarctica-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[European migrant crisis]], [[Morocco–Spain relations]]
**[[Morocco]] closes its [[Morocco–Spain border|border]] with [[Spain]] following the escalation of diplomatic tensions generated by the massive influx of migrants into [[Ceuta]] on Tuesday. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/justice-home-affairs/news/morocco-shuts-off-border-crossing-to-spain-amid-record-migrant-influx/?fbclid=IwAR1-kcH2lZL3aMcqBC0HhIJsIoUcLtpbs5PVQ8olSiUFI_DouV9aKxmwwGM (''Euractiv'')]
*[[Russia–United States relations]], [[Foreign policy of the Joe Biden administration]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] lifts sanctions on the [[Nord Stream#Nord Stream 2|Nord Stream 2]] pipeline project between [[Russia]] and [[Germany]]. Despite [[Joe Biden]]'s personal opposition to the project, the [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] says that it concluded that it was in the "U.S. national interest" to waive the sanctions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57180674 (BBC News)]
*[[International reactions to the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]], [[China–Israel relations]]
**[[Israel]] condemns an "[[Antisemitism|antisemitic]]" report by [[China]]'s state-owned [[China Global Television Network]] that claims that "wealthy [[Jews]] dominate the finance, media and internet sectors" in the [[United States]]. The report also claims that Israel is an American [[puppet state]]. The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel)|Israeli Foreign Ministry]] calls on CGTN to take down the video, citing its "racist and dangerous" ideas. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210519-israel-accuses-china-state-tv-of-blatant-anti-semitism (France 24)] [https://www.jpost.com/diaspora/antisemitism/chinese-media-us-supports-israel-because-of-wealthy-jews-668513 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro]], [[Corruption in Brazil]]
**The [[Federal Police of Brazil]] reveals an investigation against [[Ministry of the Environment (Brazil)|Environment Minister]] [[Ricardo Salles]], [[Brazilian Institute of Environment and Renewable Natural Resources|IBAMA]] president Eduardo Bim and other high-ranking officials for facilitating [[illegal logging]] in the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon region]]. Salles's fiscal and banking secrecies are lifted, and Bim is suspended from his post. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/brazil-police-investigate-top-environment-ministry-officials-brazil-rio-de-janeiro-joe-biden-europe-sao-paulo-b1850182.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]], [[January 6 commission]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] votes 252–175 to approve a [[January 6 commission|commission]] that will investigate the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6 riot]] at the [[United States Capitol]]. The bill will head to the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]]. [https://www.voanews.com/usa/us-house-votes-back-probe-january-attack-capitol (Voice of America)]
*[[International protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]
**Pro-[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] protesters gather at a [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|UAV]] factory in [[Leicester]] over its ties to [[Israel]] arms manufacture [[Elbit Systems]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/palestine-action-protest-elbit-systems-factory-israel-1592836 (''Newsweek'')]
**In [[Kuwait]], protesters burn [[Flag of Israel|Israeli flags]] and rally in support of [[Palestinians|Palestine]]. Protesters also reject [[Abraham Accords|normalization agreements]] signed by [[Bahrain]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kuwaiti-protesters-burn-israeli-flag-reject-normalisation-deals-2021-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*The Spanish ''[[Audiencia Nacional]]'' summons the leader of the [[Polisario Front]], [[Brahim Ghali]], to present himself in court on June 1 on accusations of multiple charges related to [[human rights]] violations by human rights groups and [[Western Sahara]] individuals. Ghali, who is currently hospitalized in northern Spain, refused to sign the summon, saying that he has to refer to the [[Algeria]]n [[embassy]] first. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spain-high-court-issues-war-crime-case-summons-against-polisario-front-leader-2021-05-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Qatari general election]]
**The [[Qatar]]i cabinet approves a draft law scheduling elections to the [[Consultative Assembly of Qatar|Shura Council]] for October, after several years of delays. The law also provides guidelines for voter registration and campaigning, such as allowing government employees to run and limiting expenditures to [[Qatari riyal|QAR]]2 million per candidate.  [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/20/qatar-cabinet-approves-draft-law-on-shura-council-elections (Al Jazeera English)]
*[[List of U.S. state partition proposals]]
**In the [[United States]], the [[Oregon]] counties of [[Baker County, Oregon|Baker]], [[Grant County, Oregon|Grant]], [[Lake County, Oregon|Lake]], [[Malheur County, Oregon|Malheur]], and [[Sherman County, Oregon|Sherman]] all approve measures that would require county officials to take steps to promote moving the [[Idaho]] border west to incorporate their populations. These counties join [[Jefferson County, Oregon|Jefferson]] and [[Union County, Oregon|Union]] counties that have already passed similar measures, while [[Douglas County, Oregon|Douglas]] and [[Harney County, Oregon|Harney]] counties are voting on similar measure in upcoming elections. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/oregon-counties-vote-to-secede-to-idaho/ar-BB1gUBIP (''The Hill'' via MSN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/05/21/us/oregon-idaho-secession.html (''The New York Times'')]
